title: YIELD App announces full public launch
notes: Yield App's own announcement states that the public launch occurred on 12 February 2021.

title: Yield App suspends activity and enters liquidation proceedings, citing FTX collapse
notes: Contemporaneous reporting quoting Yield App's announcement that all platform activity was suspended immediately.

title: Yield App suspends activity ahead of liquidation proceedings
notes: Reports the platform statement linking the suspension to portfolio losses through third-party hedge fund managers that held assets on FTX.

title: Yield App Limited in liquidation
notes: Official notice states that Yield App commenced insolvent liquidation and identifies the appointed joint liquidators.

title: Liquidators appointed to Yield App to oversee insolvency proceedings
notes: Joint liquidator announcement confirming liquidation effective 1 July 2024 and the creditor claims process.

title: Cork Gully reports rapid asset recovery and interim distribution in Yield App liquidation
notes: Liquidator report stating that an early interim distribution of 14 cents in the U.S. dollar was made entirely in cryptocurrency and that further recoveries remained in progress.

title: Seychelles Supreme Court clarifies treatment of commingled cryptoassets in Yield App liquidation
notes: Liquidator summary of the court's guidance that widespread commingling generally required pari passu unsecured-creditor treatment, subject to a narrow category of potentially traceable assets.

title: Yield App terms and conditions
notes: Terms state that users lend digital assets and may become general unsecured creditors if Yield cannot pay its debts.
